Name: System Monitor
Description: Live CPU, GPU, memory, disk and network gauges for your Stream Deck, in five styles with warning colors.

com.benwyrosdick.system-monitor.cpu.Name: CPU
com.benwyrosdick.system-monitor.cpu.Tooltip: Live CPU utilization. Press to refresh.

com.benwyrosdick.system-monitor.gpu.Name: GPU
com.benwyrosdick.system-monitor.gpu.Tooltip: Live GPU utilization, temperature and memory. Press to refresh.

com.benwyrosdick.system-monitor.memory.Name: Memory
com.benwyrosdick.system-monitor.memory.Tooltip: Live memory usage. Press to refresh.

com.benwyrosdick.system-monitor.disk.Name: Disk
com.benwyrosdick.system-monitor.disk.Tooltip: How full a drive is. Press to cycle through drives.

com.benwyrosdick.system-monitor.network.Name: Network
com.benwyrosdick.system-monitor.network.Tooltip: Live download or upload rate. Press to switch direction.

com.benwyrosdick.system-monitor.overview.Name: Overview
com.benwyrosdick.system-monitor.overview.Tooltip: Several metrics stacked on one key. Press to refresh.
